map.管路（壁厚/流速/压降）设计工具。输入管径、流速与长度，估算管路沿程压降并校核壁: The piping design tool takes diameter, velocity and length to estimate the friction pressure drop and check the wall thickness, used for industrial piping and hydraulic system design and selection reference.
map.按设计压力与许用应力定管壁厚。: Set the pipe wall thickness from design pressure and allowable stress.
map.流速与压降联合优化管径。: Optimize diameter with velocity and pressure drop together.
map.高压管路安全余量校核。: Safety margin check for high-pressure piping.
map.：p=100 bar=10 MPa、D=50 mm、σ=100 MPa、焊缝 1: With p = 100 bar = 10 MPa, D = 50 mm, sigma = 100 MPa and weld factor 1 -> delta = pD/(2 sigma) = 10x50/(2x100) = 2.5 mm, so take the standard 3 mm.
map.：同流量下管径小则 v 大、压降∝v²，壁厚与能耗要同时权衡。: At the same flow a smaller diameter means a higher velocity and pressure drop proportional to v^2, so wall thickness and energy use must be weighed together.
map.壁厚公式适用？: Does the Wall Thickness Formula Apply?
map.薄壁圆筒 pD/2σ 近似，厚壁用拉美公式，焊缝系数与腐蚀余量另加。: Thin-wall cylinders use the pD/2 sigma approximation, thick walls use the Lamé formula, and the weld factor and corrosion allowance are added separately.
map.按管材屈服除以安全系数，并计温度折减与腐蚀余量。: Divide the pipe material yield by the safety factor, and include a temperature derating and a corrosion allowance.
